read_locator: ModuleNotFoundError; FileNotFoundError; KeyError; IndexError; SyntaxError; IndentationError; TabError
own_summary: Read each listed class and conditions. A missing module raises ModuleNotFoundError (also sys.modules None); missing requested file or directory raises FileNotFoundError; missing mapping key raises KeyError; scalar sequence subscript out of range raises IndexError, while slices truncate. Parser errors raise SyntaxError; incorrect indentation is a SyntaxError subclass. Advice in W.7 gives first diagnostics rather than claiming these are exhaustive causes.
